question: Olivado avocado oil company owner parent brand
markdown:
Olivado is owned and operated as the
⁠Olivado Group
, an independent New Zealand-based company founded in 1999 by a group of chefs and scientists. It operates independently with production facilities in New Zealand and
⁠Olivado EPZ Ltd
in Kenya, rather than being a subsidiary of a larger multinational parent conglomerate.
